notes.trainable: false for noisy samples; noisy samples are stored for audit but should not be used for training
notes.mirror: mirror rows live in phase/mirror.jsonl and preserve phase/quality/type while swapping color and board orientation
notes.negative_contract: negative rows keep the same good_move but expose one selected bad move in bad_moves[0]
notes.sequence_contract: sequence contains 2 to 5 consecutive best moves from the source game starting at the sample ply
